titleWithFolder: Sync the whole mod to {dir}/ (takes effect after restarting the mod in HOI4)
titleNoFolder: The first time, you'll pick a mod folder. It's reused for the rest of this session.
tooltipContent:
HOI4 mod testing workflow (create + Debug + logs):
1. Put the chosen mod folder in %userprofile%\Documents\Paradox Interactive\Hearts of Iron IV\mod\
2. Launcher → Mod library → tick this mod
3. Enable Debug mode, either way:
   • Steam · right-click HOI4 → Properties → General → enter -debug in launch options
   • Local · create a dowser.exe shortcut → Properties → append " -debug" to Target (note the space before the dash)
4. Launch the game · error.log pops up automatically (Notepad) once the main menu finishes loading
5. Error triage · three categories in error.log:
   • Family · cross-mod / cross-entity naming idiom drift
   • Vanilla compatible · compatibility with vanilla (DLC fields / version)
   • Mod-internal · inside this mod (broken ID / circular ref)
6. Log location · %userprofile%\Documents\...\logs\ (error.log + game.log)
> Note: some severe errors may not be logged before a crash · diagnose with in-game symptoms + game.log together.
includeImportedTitleOn: Include content imported from the original mod (vanilla or old-mod sources). Writes the full mod folder.
includeImportedTitleOff: Sync only the entities you created or modified. Don't overwrite old imported content.
wrotePartial: ⚠ Wrote {ok}/{total} files, {failed} failed (e.g. {firstError}). The mod folder is partially updated.
additiveCaption: Sync only writes or overwrites; it never deletes.
additiveWarning: Sync only writes or overwrites files; it never deletes. If you renamed, deleted, or re-tagged an entity, the old .txt/.yml/.dds stays in the folder and the game loads both the old and new versions. After such changes, manually clear the mod's generated folders (common/, events/, history/, localisation/, gfx/) before syncing, or sync into a fresh folder.
